universe: January cash turnover cohort. Monthly exchange membership kept under a release guard.

hypotheses.name: Dated archive reconstruction
hypotheses.mechanism: Official monthly weights may track the price index after drift
hypotheses.inputs: Official monthly membership/weight files and exchange cash
hypotheses.minimum: 50 verified NIFTY 50 weights and matching close
hypotheses.budget: 22 vintage months and two archive series
hypotheses.follow_up: Prefer dated-weight investable observations and report tracking breaks
hypotheses.cutoff: 08:55 inputs, same-window 09:10 native comparisons where stated

hypotheses.name: Constrained sectors
hypotheses.mechanism: A low-dimensional causal fit may reconstruct the index
hypotheses.budget: One stable simplex fit plus training-only factors
hypotheses.follow_up: Compare extrapolation and scope by cohort
hypotheses.cutoff: 08:55 inputs, same-window 09:10 native comparisons where stated

hypotheses.name: Market decomposition
hypotheses.mechanism: Most stock variation may lie in market and sector terms
hypotheses.follow_up: Measure weighted cancellation of security residuals
hypotheses.cutoff: 08:55 inputs, same-window 09:10 native comparisons where stated

hypotheses.name: Equity pooling
hypotheses.mechanism: Pooled observations can improve shared financial relationships
hypotheses.target_metric: Stock CRPS, RMSE and date-rank IC
hypotheses.negative_control: Randomized relative labels and shifted features
hypotheses.follow_up: Continue only if component performance or estimation improves
hypotheses.cutoff: 08:55 inputs, same-window 09:10 native comparisons where stated

hypotheses.name: Equity law calibration
hypotheses.mechanism: Matured residuals may calibrate absolute and active return uncertainty
hypotheses.inputs: Equity labels and prior daily volatility
hypotheses.target_metric: Absolute, relative, normalized, sign, magnitude and risk
hypotheses.negative_control: Training-only chronological scale and grouping controls
hypotheses.minimum: Finite paired outcomes and at least 30 return observations
hypotheses.budget: Compact Gaussian or empirical marginal laws
hypotheses.follow_up: Test whether component gains survive aggregation
hypotheses.cutoff: 08:55 inputs, same-window 09:10 native comparisons where stated

hypotheses.name: Sector contributions
hypotheses.mechanism: Sector or stock-derived predictions may add distinct index content
hypotheses.inputs: Dated index sectors and pooled stock returns
hypotheses.negative_control: Stock-to-sector vs direct sector vs constant drift
hypotheses.minimum: Mature sector labels and matched date support
hypotheses.budget: One causal ridge by weighting lane
hypotheses.follow_up: Require agreement with strong index parent
hypotheses.cutoff: 08:55 inputs, same-window 09:10 native comparisons where stated

hypotheses.name: Common market
hypotheses.mechanism: Pooled absolute exposures may estimate the common target better
hypotheses.inputs: Stock absolute/relative models, official market state
hypotheses.strong_reference: Matched NIFTY-only historical and archived V20
hypotheses.negative_control: Shifted auxiliary features and common-only arm
hypotheses.budget: One factor model, one NIFTY-only ridge, two nulls
hypotheses.follow_up: Retain only evidence beyond common exposure
hypotheses.cutoff: 08:55 inputs, same-window 09:10 native comparisons where stated

hypotheses.name: Joint dependence
hypotheses.mechanism: Paired historical factors and residuals restore diversification risk
hypotheses.inputs: Joint terminal stock or sector errors
hypotheses.target_metric: Index CRPS, variance and interval coverage
hypotheses.strong_reference: Strong empirical parent and unconditional joint covariance
hypotheses.negative_control: Independent, shrunk, Gaussian and heavy-tail controls
hypotheses.minimum: Matured return vectors with reported missing weights
hypotheses.cutoff: 08:55 inputs, same-window 09:10 native comparisons where stated

hypotheses.name: Bottom-up versus direct
hypotheses.mechanism: Aggregation may improve forecasts when component effects survive
hypotheses.target_metric: Index Brier, log loss and CRPS
hypotheses.strong_reference: V20 metric leaders at 09:10 and archived 08:55
hypotheses.negative_control: Equal complexity direct and historical aggregation
hypotheses.minimum: Exact target date and complete law
hypotheses.budget: Fixed top-down, sector, stock, factor and mixture arms
hypotheses.follow_up: Insist on matched performance and historical uncertainty
hypotheses.cutoff: 08:55 inputs, same-window 09:10 native comparisons where stated

hypotheses.name: Index residual

hypotheses.inputs: Earlier errors from exact V20 distributions
hypotheses.negative_control: Bias, scale, asymmetry and fixed mixture
hypotheses.budget: One chronological capped ridge per mechanism
hypotheses.cutoff: 08:55 inputs, same-window 09:10 native comparisons where stated

hypotheses.name: Concentration
hypotheses.mechanism: Focus of leadership may change forecast usefulness
hypotheses.inputs: Dated weights, synchronized stock moves and breadth
hypotheses.target_metric: Index or volatility error by causal regime
hypotheses.negative_control: Random subsets and removal of heavyweight securities

hypotheses.budget: One regime map with fixed thresholds
hypotheses.follow_up: Require robust group effects before gating

hypotheses.name: Portfolio risk
